g.text: Frozen-cell descriptive estimates. 1–1 paired repetitions/cell. Cells weighted equally; bands/bars are ±1 Monte Carlo SE. Fixed display shortlist; every method remains in the
CSV tables. Snapshot cell counts may differ across horizons.
